datasheet_id_and_revision: SBOS268C, December 2002, revised December 2008 (PDF pp. 1-20); Package Option Addendum 11-Nov-2025 (PDF pp. 21-22); package materials and drawings DBV0005A, D0008A (PDF pp. 23-31); notice PDF p32.
datasheet_status: PRODUCTION DATA (footer, PDF p1). Addendum (text-located, PDF p21): all orderable versions Active.
scope_note: Headline extraction only (survey priority lower than OPA846/OPA847): spec table, front pages, open-loop and noise curves, TIA example. Typical-characteristic pages other than the open-loop and noise plots, and the applications pages other than PDF p11, were not digitized.

conventions.type_codes: TYP = typical; MIN_25C / MAX_25C = guaranteed at 25 C (level A = 100% tested at 25 C; B = characterization and simulation); MIN_0_70C / MAX_0_70C / MIN_m40_85C / MAX_m40_85C = over-temperature limits (characterization and simulation). CURVE = PDF vector path with tick-label calibration, checked on a 120 dpi render. DERIVED = computed here.
conventions.table_default_conditions: TA = 25 C, VS = +/-5 V, RF = 402 ohm, RL = 100 ohm, G = +5 unless noted; AC per Figure 1 (PDF p3). Typical characteristics: G = +5, RF = 402, RG = 100, RL = 100 (PDF pp. 4-8).

input_type: bipolar ('classic' differential input, PDF p1; 'very high-speed complementary bipolar process', PDF p19, located by text)
compensation: decompensated voltage feedback ('two gain-stage design', medium gain); flat at G = +5, peaking 3.5 dB at G = +3

datasheet_statements: 'Operating at a noise gain less than +3 runs the risk of sustained oscillation (loop instability)' (PDF p14).
Table: small-signal bandwidth at G = +3 500 MHz typ, peaking at a gain of +3 3.5 dB typ (PDF p3).
'unity-gain stability is not required for transimpedance applications' (PDF p11).

External compensation below the minimum gain: noninverting resistor across the inputs and inverting low-gain compensation with NG2 = 1 + CS/CF > minimum stable gain (example target NG2 = 7.5) (PDF p14).

supply.dual_or_single: dual (table specifies +/-4 V minimum to +/-6 V maximum operating)
supply.recommended: +/-5 V specified (TYP); maximum operating +/-6 V, minimum operating +/-4 V (both level A). Absolute maximum +/-6.5 VDC.

gbw.param: GBW implied by open-loop plot (f x |AOL|)

open_loop_dc_gain.value: about 116 dB at 10-100 Hz on the typical plot

phase_margin_or_crossover.note: inconsistent with the 3.5 dB peaking tabulated at G = +3, so the plot does not include all loop phase (e.g. input/feedback capacitance)

open_loop_curve.figure: Open-Loop Gain and Phase (PDF p7, top right)
open_loop_curve.conditions: VS = +/-5 V, TA = 25 C; page default RL = 100 ohm (not stated on the plot)
open_loop_curve.phase_convention: phase of AOL, 0 deg at DC, plotted to -210 deg (right axis); phase margin = 180 deg + phase at crossover
open_loop_curve.axes: gain -20 to 120 dB, phase 0 to -210 deg, 10 Hz to 1 GHz

points.note: phase trace reaches -210 deg at about 0.98 GHz

open_loop_output_impedance.note: not given; closed-loop output impedance 0.0001 ohm typ at G = +5, 1 kHz (PDF p3) and a closed-loop plot on PDF p7 (not digitized)

large_signal_bw.note: not tabulated; large-signal response plots on PDF p4 not digitized

overdrive_recovery.note: plots on PDF p7 not digitized (headline scope)

voltage_noise.curve_src: PDF p6 Input Voltage and Current Noise Density, 100 Hz-10 MHz (CURVE +/-3%)

current_noise.hf_behavior: flat to 10 MHz (end of plot); not shown above 10 MHz
current_noise.how_measured_or_defined: single table value 'Input Current Noise, f > 1 MHz'; input not specified

input_capacitance.definition_notes: Table: Differential-Mode 12 kohm || 1 pF, Common-Mode 3.2 Mohm || 1.2 pF (PDF p3). TIA text: 'common-mode and differential mode input capacitances CI = (1.0 + 1.2)pF' added to the diode capacitance, CS = CD + CI (PDF p11).

output_swing_vs_load_curve.note: plot on PDF p7 not digitized

imd_or_oip3.value: > 30 dBm up to 50 MHz, > 50 dBm below 10 MHz; 44 MHz IF example 33 dBm at 200 mW dissipation

packages.name: SO-8 (D, D0008A)
packages.body_mm: 4.81-5.00 x 3.81-3.98, max height 1.75 (same drawing as OPA846)
packages.notes: OPA843ID (rails 100 on p2; tube 75 in addendum), OPA843IDR (2500); marking OPA843

pinout_notes: Same pinout as OPA846. SO-8: 1 NC, 2 -IN, 3 +IN, 4 -VS, 5 NC, 6 OUT, 7 +VS, 8 NC. SOT23-5: 1 OUT, 2 -VS, 3 +IN, 4 -IN, 5 +VS. No shutdown pin.

tia_content.what: Photodiode transimpedance amplifier example (schematic captioned 'FIGURE 3. High Dynamic Range IF Amplifier' by mistake; text calls it Figure 4)
tia_content.C_F: 0.75 pF external (0.94 pF total incl. 0.2 pF resistor parasitic)
tia_content.C_D_or_source_C: 20 pF diode; CS = CD + CI with CI = (1.0 + 1.2) pF
tia_content.bandwidth: feedback pole 16.9 MHz (Eq. 1); about 24 MHz -3 dB (Eq. 2)

tia_content.equations: Eq. 1: 1/(2 pi RF CF) = sqrt(GBP/(4 pi RF CS)), CS = CD + CI. Eq. 2: F-3dB ~ sqrt(GBP/(2 pi RF CS)) Hz. 'ideal wideband transimpedance amplifier for low to moderate gains'.

application_guidance: Not extracted beyond the TIA section and compensation statements (headline scope).

abs_max_and_input_protection.ESD: HBM 2000 V, CDM 1500 V, MM 200 V

other_notes: Front-page feature list: 260 MHz (G = +5), 800 MHz GBP, 2.0 nV/rtHz, -96 dBc (5 MHz), 110 dB AOL, 10.5 ns 0.01% settling, 300 uV VOS, +/-100 mA (PDF p1).
Open-loop plot implies about 670 MHz GBW versus the 800 MHz typical.
Minimum operating supply +/-4 V (table) - unlike OPA846/OPA847 no +5 V single-supply statement was located (not searched exhaustively).
TIA schematic caption duplicates 'FIGURE 3. High Dynamic Range IF Amplifier' (PDF p11).
